notes.title: Deathsmiles V1.1.3.0 Fix for Crash on Startup
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Detail[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for crash at startup[/list]

As promised in the DoDonPachi annoucement, Cave have been able to implement the fix for the crash at startup which had been affecting some of you.
The trigger was a little more complicated than number of friends on an account which is why it took time to fix: if you still experience problems, please get in touch.
The slow down experienced by some people after accessing leaderboards/scores is still being looked into: we'll keep you informed.

notes.title: Steam Halloween Sale ft. Deathsmiles & Hi Score Contest!
notes.content:
It's the season of the witch once more; a time for carving pumpkins, trick or treating and, of course, shmups! Here at Degica, we're all out of pumpkins so instead we've put Deathsmiles and all three of its soundtracks 50% off.

And to celebrate, with [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/464450]DoDonPachi Resurrection[/url] released and its first [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/464450/announcements/detail/818919582816444617]hi score contest[/url] all done, what better time for a Deathsmiles contest?

We're launching two, single player contests: the first for beginners on Normal mode, the second for the more experienced shooters amongst you. NB to encourage more people to participate, winners of the second contest will be exempt from the first.

[h1]Contest 1: Bullet Helloween[/h1]
Start: 28th October 10am
Finish: 4th November 10am
Rules: Achieve as high as possible a score in Score Attack: Normal with EX Stages during the contest period. Don't forget to include a replay! The top 3 scores will receive a prize.
* Winners from Contest 2 will be excluded
Prizes:
1st Place: art book & original sound track CD
2nd Place: art book
3rd Place: Your choice of any Cave game on Steam or their respective DLC.

[h1]Contest 2: Pumpking Smashers[/h1]
Start: 28th October 10am
Finish: 4th November 10am
Rules: Achieve as high as possible a score in Score Attack: Mega Black Label Normal with EX Stages during the contest period. Don't forget to include a replay!
Prizes:
1st Place: art book & original sound track CD
2nd Place: art book
3rd Place: Your choice of any Cave game on Steam or their respective DLC.

[h1]Prizes[/h1]
Death Smiles Art Book
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12049889/46b1fd9dafd54da86011769eea35aaecd552b7b9.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12049889/b81cac05a3dd85cc8a8c8a792e209139aec8462e.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Deathsmiles is Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hello, everyone, pretty exciting announcement for you today!

As you can see, [i]Deathsmiles[/i] is coming soon to Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/314180/
[h1]Featuring:[/h1][list]
[*]Horizontally scrolling bullet-hell madness across six different game modes including Mega Black Label mode. 
[*]Spooky good fun! Battle ghosts, demons, man-eating plants, and even giant cattle in this gothic horror-themed adventure. 
[*]Five playable angels to choose from, each with her own faithful familiar.
